displayPattern: Amber LED on a Bryant 80% two-stage variable-speed furnace (troubleshooting guide TG-GFB80-02). Short flashes are the first digit and long flashes are the second. Code 43 is 4 short and 3 long
meaning: Low-heat pressure switch is open while the high-heat pressure switch is closed. The chart says to check the pressure tubing, low inlet gas pressure if a low-gas-pressure switch is used, mis-wired switches, and a low-heat switch stuck open.
causes: Low inlet gas pressure, if a low-gas-pressure switch is used
diySteps: Count 4 short flashes and 3 long flashes. Do not swap the pressure-switch hoses to see what happens
Technician: check tubing, switch wiring, and the low-heat switch. Gas pressure, if an LGPS is used, is part of that check
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Two pressure switches disagreeing is not a vent-cap cleaning.
sourceTitle: Bryant 80% variable-speed two-stage furnace troubleshooting guide (Catalog No. TG-GFB80-02)
